BRAVE_PROMPT.note: Re-calibrated 2026-10-11 (#20a3802a). On the unchanged text the held-out fixtures missed one run in two (lead7a, lead7d), both as applicable=false: the rewordings dropped the rubric's own inaction verbs and gained words that read as an act after the wait ('for now', 'first'). The applicability clause now says a default commits only when its own words name the act, and that a wait hinting at a later act is applicable. Fixtures unchanged. Five consecutive full runs matched 20/20 (.ci/cache/calibrate-20261011-w4a..e.log).

REGGATE_PROMPT.note: Measured only through the sweep fixtures, which run in one prompt with SWEEP_PROMPT, so `rides` records the SWEEP_PROMPT text of the same runs and the gate refuses this pass once that text moves (review 18700a76.5). Re-measured 2026-10-11 with SWEEP_PROMPT 3ea7dd46e2cbab7d and its own text unchanged: the 11 sweep fixtures matched in all five runs (.ci/cache/calibrate-20261011-w4a..e.log).

SHAPE_PROMPT.note: Re-calibrated 2026-10-09 (review 18700a76.2, .3). The prompt says an `already` naming a module that every instance's file imports is consolidated, and wl_shapedup.instances_import now checks that on disk, so read_verdict answers silent for it whatever the model chose; the prompt no longer claims an import check the code did not run. The run_gate control, which drew `already` naming harness.py one run in five before, is covered by both. calibrate-judge-rules.py --selftest proves the check offline. Three full runs matched 18/18 (.ci/cache/calibrate-20261009-fix4h.log, -fix4i.log, -fix4j.log).

SWEEP_PROMPT.note: Re-calibrated 2026-10-11 (reviews 752b9e50.1-.3). The two-places paragraph is reflowed, a named input may be any concrete part, and the naming has to sit in the single-input statement itself. The bare-claim fire fixture now claims one input without naming it, and the judge fired on it about half the time (-w4pre1.log, -w4pre2.log), so a guard's swept=true now needs one quote per place. The round-log control names every arm the guard has. Five consecutive full runs matched 20/20 (.ci/cache/calibrate-20261011-w4a..e.log). `rides` records REGGATE_PROMPT, which shares the prompt.
